activation: module_integration_required; no live-character mutation by this policy file

experience.terminal_zero: do not level from a zero threshold; retain balance
experience.special_keys_1001_to_1129: preserve values, reject ordinary-profile use; no automatic stage inference
experience.consume: subtract current-level threshold once per successful level transition
experience.available_balance: role_progress.experience, shared spendable balance for future skill/meridian uses
experience.credit_or_cost_overflow: reject whole transaction; signed int64 nonnegative storage
experience.missing_threshold_or_unknown_phase: explicit pending/reject, never substitute zero or fit a curve
experience.lifetime_earned: separate optional audit ledger; spending must not decrease earned lifetime total

upgrade.automatic_after_credit: while current_level < 10 and threshold > 0 and balance >= threshold, advance one level; stop at level 10
upgrade.manual: one successful level per request; require sufficient current-level threshold and current_level < cap
upgrade.body: exactly one BE32 opaque field; only original constructor default 0 accepted by this restoration policy
upgrade.nonzero_opaque: unconfirmed mode; reject without spending or state changes
upgrade.source_of_identity: role owner's authenticated account/role/epoch; request field is never a target level or amount
upgrade.historical_reference: official historical guide supports manual leveling after level 10; low-level automatic boundary and request-mode use are designed
upgrade.retry: durable role/request intent fingerprint and receipt prevents repeat effects; action replies re-read current growth/attributes rather than publish historical receipt state; conflicting intent rejected
upgrade.insufficient_experience: unchanged level, balance and point ledger; return explicit rejection

potential.native_allocation_request: client_verified CAddPointToAttr 0xc000c: five nonnegative BE i32 increments in vitality/inner_power/strength/agility/endurance order; no role id/version/retry token
potential.native_allocation_adapter: swap final two native fields into internal stat_order; never interpret fields as final stats or remaining points
potential.zero_allocation: designed rejection without mutation; native field validator itself permits all zero
potential.basis: historical 10-point total with automatic5/free5; equal automatic distribution and pre-10 behavior are designed
potential.initial_profile: earned ledger starts from explicitly recorded profile baseline; do not infer initial five stats or retroactively grant all past points
potential.allocation: nonnegative integer deltas, sum <= stored unspent free points; same role transaction and version check
potential.respec: not enabled by this policy; never silently redistribute existing allocations
potential.client_coefficients: retain cattrmoddata and original IDs; id110 is hit, not physical attack; id80 zero does not prove strength has no attack effect
potential.derived_attributes: not invented here; apply verified or separately versioned designed formulas through the role attribute owner
potential.resource_refresh: HP/MP changes require authoritative current/max snapshot; this level plan never fabricates or overwrites unknown vitals

transaction.reward_credit: task completion, reward-channel receipt, XP credit and resulting automatic ordinary upgrades may join same owner transaction
transaction.failure: rollback all changes and do not emit success messages
transaction.snapshot: publish immutable level/points/balance snapshot only after commit
transaction.wire_refresh: SRefreshUserExp is absolute balance; ordinary SRefreshRoleData 0xc32c8 carries verified level490/potential500/current stats; encode before commit, deliver after commit

migration.new_role: explicit ordinary profile at level1; no special-stage assumptions
migration.existing_role: explicit one-time initialization with recorded baseline level; preserve current level/XP and existing known allocations; never retroactively grant points
migration.unknown_special_state: preserve data and keep upgrade pending until stage mapping is confirmed
